item.paragraph: Dr Albert Davis examined Ms Alice Newman and found that the pacemaker is operating properly and the breathlessness is due to high fever and anxiety.
Ms Alice Newman was tested for the Urinanalysis macro panel and the results have been found to be normal.
Ms Alice Newman seems to be developing high fever and hence we recommend her to get admitted to a nearby hospital using the provided referral.
